headline: New extraction models and coding assistants arrive, while supply chain security requires audits

calls.title: Trial MAI Code 2 for pipeline engineering
calls.text: Test MAI Code 2 and Flash on GitHub Copilot to accelerate data pipeline engineering for financial services clients. High performance at lower price points can improve developer velocity across our Nashik delivery teams.

calls.title: Evaluate new frontier models for extraction
calls.text: Evaluate GPT-6.2 Astra and Gemini 4 Neon on 30 complex private equity reports. Compare field extraction accuracy and latency against current models to optimize document automation costs.

calls.title: Audit agent dependencies for supply-chain risks
calls.text: Audit and lock down all dependency packages used in agentic workflow development. Following the compromise of Microsoft's official Agent Framework PyPI package, verify all sources before deployment.
